1.w: Hallelu YAH! I will give thanks to YHWH with all of [my] heart, in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

2.w: Great [are] the works of YHWH, being searched out by all [who] delight in them.

3.w: Splendor and majesty [are] His work, and His righteousness stands forever.

4.w: A memorial He has made by His wonders; gracious and compassionate [is] YHWH.

5.w: Food He has given to those fearing Him; He remembers His covenant forever.

6.w: The power of His works He has declared to His people, by giving to them the inheritance of the nations.

7.w: The works of His hands [are] truth and justice, [and] all His precepts are trustworthy.

8.w: They are upheld for ever everlasting; they are made in truth and uprightness.

9.w: Redemption He has sent to His people; He has appointed His covenant forever; Holy and awesome [is] His name!

10.w: The beginning of wisdom [is] the fear of YHWH; good understanding [is] unto all those doing it. May His praise be enduring forever!
